event_name: DENSO NHRA Sonoma Nationals presented by PowerEdge

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 73 degrees, relative humidity 59 percent, barometer 29.90 inches, adjusted
altitude 1,459 feet.

The #1 FC qualifier is 8 - 7 in the Final round at this event. The last time the #1 FC qualifier won this race was 2024.

Vandergriff is 1 - 0 against Wilkerson in prior events and this is the first time they have faced each other
in a final round.

Wilkerson with the starting line advantage, but Vandergriff has the difference made up by 100 feet and never
trailed from there on for the win.  Vandergriff wins his second Wally.
